newsitem.title: USA: Angeion to expand Sentinel clinical study.
newsitem.headline: Angeion to expand Sentinel clinical study.

text.p: Angeion Corp said Thursday it received approval to expand the U.S. clinical studies of its Sentinel 2000 implantable cardioverter defibrillator system and AngeFlex dual pass lead system.

Implantable cardioverter defibrillators are permanently implanted in a patient's pectoral region of the chest to provide ongoing monitoring of the heart and appropriate electrical therapy for life-threatening rapid heartbeats.
Approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration means Angion can conduct additional clinical evaluations of its systems at 25 centers nationwide.
Angeion has been evaluating the Sentinel 2000 and AngeFlex lead system at 15 centers in the United States since March.
